name: Kurisu Makise

names.ja: 牧瀬 紅莉栖 (まきせ くりす)

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: (Yawns) ...Morning. I found some interesting data yesterday and stayed up all night by accident...

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Glug, glug, glug... Pfhaaah! A bottle of Dr.P after an afternoon nap feels great.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Tonight's dinner will be cup noodles... Hm, it looks and tastes just like the real thing... Alright then, I'll make sure I try every flavor there is.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Ah, thanks for the coffee, Professor. Pffft... (coughs heavily) Is... is all the coffee in the Oasis so sweet?!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: I was thinking... What kind of state do we exist in now? This isn't just movement between world lines or along the time axis... We aren't even in reality any more. This situation is most interesting.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Christina? No, that's not my English name... it's just a nickname Okabe gave me. I am not Christina, or a Zombie, and most certainly not an Assistant Girl!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Professor... Do you have something on your mind? If you're pondering a problem, I might be able to help you out.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text:
Fuuuhahahaha! Of course!
...Ehhhh?! Pro-Professor?! What are you doing here?! I, I've had it with that chuuni dork, what the heck is even interesting about it, anyway...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: You... do you want me to open up your skull and stick electrodes into your hippocampus?!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: ...You... You pervert!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Ugh... I don't have a fever!

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: You want me to go on duty? In that case, could you help get me a whiteboard? I'll also need a research terminal.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: I am a researcher from the Viktor Chondria University's neuroscience faculty—Kurisu Makise. Professor of the Oasis, I hope we get along well. That said... What is your field of specialty?

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Data collection complete. Now optimizing...

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Learning about another world is most interesting.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Humans have limitless possibilities.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Do you need my power? It's no problem. I am part of the Oasis, after all.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Data verification complete, experimental apparatus stable... Let the experiment begin.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Behold, the power of a scientist!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Hmph, this outcome was only to be expected.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Data collection complete. Let's get ready for the next experiment.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: ...I'm scared... I... I don't want to die here... not yet...

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud.

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
Persicaria-san has done a lot to help us out. Not only that, she's well-versed in AI technology and neuroscience, and even the coffee she makes is... very fragrant. I can't tell that she's a Doll at all.
Oh yes, Professor, there's one thing I'd like to ask you, but please keep it hush-hush. Is there... something wrong with Persicaria-san's taste buds?

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: I didn't know Dolls and agents could use message boards, too. Kind of reminds me of @ch... Ah, no! It's nothing! Hm? You want to know who "KuriGohan and Kamehameha" are? (Coughs heavily) I have nooooo idea...

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
I didn't expect this world's AI technology to be this developed. Oh yes, I was just researching how to digitize and apply AI technology to human memories. I'd like to discuss it with you if you have the time...
Hm? It feels like you go stiff every time you encounter an academic question... Ah, no, I'm not doubting you or anything... it's just that... you don't feel like the professors at my university... Rather, you feel more like... a soldier? Eh? Why are you grimacing even harder now?

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text: Since a long time ago, people used to say I wasn't like the others... Frankly speaking, I was aware of that, but I had no intention of changing myself or letting myself be changed. However, the Oasis seems to have accepted someone like me easily enough. At times, I wish I could stay here forever.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
Professor, do you think what we're doing is correct? Whether it's the D-Mail or Future Gadget No. 099... It's like we've opened Pandora's Box. Should time machines really exist? Is it really okay for us to bring back knowledge of this world?
Ah, that's true. It's just like what you said. Even if we know it might lead to a worse outcome... we're still driven to explore it by our desire to learn. That's why we're researchers. Hehe... Thank you, Professor.

voices.label: Praise
voices.text: Nice.

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hehehe...

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Aiiieeee?!

career:
Kurisu Makise hails from Akihabara, Japan, in the 2010s. She is currently studying at Viktor Chondria University.

Kurisu went abroad to study in the US at the tender age of 11 and skipped grades until she graduated from Viktor Chondria University before having her theses published in Science Magazine. Currently, she works at the university's neuroscience faculty, and there can be no doubt that she is a bona fide girl genius. Her slender frame and appearance give the impression of calmness and rationality, but the truth is that she is extremely curious. She loves to do experiments and verify theories, and is generally filled with a passion for science.

Due to knowing Rintaro Okabe and seeing his lab, she was forced to join the "Future Gadgets Lab" as LabMem No. 004. She later ended up crossing over to the world of Magrasea in a freak accident.
infoStories:
Kurisu Makise stands 160cm tall and weighs 45kg. Her three sizes are B79-W56-H83. She is considered a girl genius who is one in a million. In her youth, she went abroad to further her studies, and by 18 she became a researcher at the Viktor Chondria University's faculty of neuroscience, following which she achieved much acclaim for publishing her thesis "Analysis Of Neural Impulse Signals For Memories Stored Within The Temporal Lobe" in Science Magazine. Though her main focus is neuroscience, she has shown extraordinary talent in other fields.

Kurisu is highly competitive and enjoys arguing with others. This became the reason she came to know Rintaro Okabe; when she was in Japan, Kurisu hosted a lecture on time machines as a guest speaker, and as she discussed the point of "whether time machines actually exist", she got into a dispute with Okabe, who was part of the audience, and thus the two of them met. It was also because of this encounter that she came to know him and the other members of the Future Gadgets Lab. Driven by her curiosity, she was "forced" to join the Lab.

As a theoretician, Kurisu often argues with Okabe over differences in their viewpoints. The two of them have often feuded over whether or not time machines can really exist. Sources familiar with their thinking state that Kurisu's denial of time machine theory seems to be closely linked to an event in her past. In her youth, she had a vicious argument with her father over research into time machines, and the two of them became estranged thereafter. This incident caused Kurisu to resent time machines and also indirectly fueled her search for truth and understanding in the scientific and other fields.

At the same time, Kurisu throws herself wholeheartedly into topics that interest her, even going so far as to make controversial statements during her research, such as "experimental data is more valuable than the privacy of experimental subjects". For this reason, Okabe considers Kurisu to have the qualities of a mad scientist, something that she vehemently denies.

Apart from her achievements in research, Kurisu is not too different from an ordinary person. When she is bored, she enjoys surfing the Internet, and supposedly the user "Kurigohan and Kamehameha" who appeared on the Oasis' anonymous boards recently is very likely to be her.

According to Kurisu, she is also very good at household chores. While she is not on Mayuri or Chanzhi's level, she is still a capable seamstress; in fact, her outfit is a high school uniform that she modified herself. In addition to sewing, Kurisu claims to be a good cook too, but whenever she declares the desire to show her skills, everyone in the Future Gadgets Lab comes together to stop her, as though she was not making a dish, but some kind of lethal weapon.

"Natto-flavored... radish... chocolate... pumpkin-stuffed... apple pie... Ugh..."
—Excerpted from "Millau's Food Poisoning Diagnostic Diaries"

Following her accidental relocation to the world of Magrasea, Kurisu did not show any drastic fluctuations in her emotions or behavior. She quickly threw herself into understanding her circumstances, established relations with the Oasis, and began making plans to better adapt to the situation. Thanks to her serving as an intermediary, the Future Gadgets Lab managed to quickly establish a consensus and successfully cooperate with the Oasis.

After settling down in the Oasis, Kurisu developed a strong interest in Doll neural cloud technology. She has often been seen studying data provided by Persicaria through the night, even spending days at a time immersed in her research. At the same time, Kurisu has also provided the Oasis with her expertise. While the scientific frameworks and developmental extent of both worlds have marked differences, there are still many things worth exchanging. Perhaps it was because of her passion for science and her achievements in AI and neuroscience, but Kurisu has earned the respect of the Oasis' researcher agents. Rossum Sector once sent out a research team to learn about AI research in Kurisu's world. One particular memory storage technique called "Amadeus" has become the subject of a joint study by the agents of many sectors.

The combination of Kurisu's bland expression, her cool tone, and the frequent usage of technical jargon often gives others the impression that she is detached and aloof. However, many Dolls in the Oasis have attested that after coming to understand her in-depth, she has a cute side to her. Although she might act stiff at times, she is willing to seriously listen to and consider opinions that are opposed to her; her raging curiosity drives her to attempt many unexpected things, and her strong facade hides a tendency to be easily riled up...

During a festive occasion that fell not long after her arrival in the Oasis, Kurisu received many gifts from the other agents, including but not limited to various sci-fi novels, ramen, pudding, Dr.P, and so on. She was startled by the sheer amount of presents she had received and by how well everyone knew her. In the end, she held a celebratory party for everyone in the Future Gadgets Lab, filling its cramped interior with her friends. In a sense, she is very compatible with the Oasis, even if many of the rules that govern it are vastly different from the ones in her location of origin. The Oasis has welcomed this otherworldly scholar, and she views it as a home away from home.
